spans.s: घोष an external effort in the pronun- ciation of a sonant or a soft con- sonant which causes depth of the tone: cf. अन्ये तु घोषाः स्युः संवृताः etc., Sid. Kau. on
घोषवत् a consonant characterized by the property घोष， at the time of its utterance; cf. तृतीयचतुर्थाः संवृतकण्ठाः नादानुप्रदाना घोषवन्तः M.Bh. on P,
